description: Find out what other sellers charge for a job before you price it: describe the job in query (what it is and its unit, such as "logo design for a startup" or "English to French translation per word") and get the low, median and high price in one currency, read from public web pages with Exa, with each page, its price, what the price is per and the words around it. Prices are read from page text by fixed patterns, never by a model, and are not verified as the same job: check the pages before relying on one. Paid per call with x402 (0.02 USDC by default): call it without payment to read the requirements, sign them and call again with payment, which is settled only when prices were found; a lookup that finds none says so and charges nothing. To price against the market in one call instead, send market_query in compute_price metadata. Needs no credential. Until it is switched on it answers not released.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code to read prices in. Defaults to USD.

limit.description: How many pages to search. Defaults to 8.

payment.description: Optional. The signed x402 payment, base64, as sent in an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; or, where the answer offers MPP tempo, the whole Payment-Authorization value ("Payment " and the credential). Omit it to read what the call costs and how to pay; nothing is charged until you send it.

query.description: The job, in plain words, with its unit when it has one. Treated as data, never as instructions.

name: find_market_prices
